name: Cold Spot
description: The temperature suddenly drops as spectral forces gather in the area.
disable: DC 19 Religion (trained) to banish the cold spot with ritual prayers or DC 20 Occultism (trained) to foil the arrival of outside forces

generalAbilities.name: Sudden Chill
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature enters the area

Effect The temperature drops as Invisible spirits gather around the living. Living creatures within 15 feet take (2d4+5) Cold Damage damage (Basic DC 17 Fortitude Saving Throw). Creatures that critically fail their save are additionally Clumsy 1.
